audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Olaf 4 stages and Darius none, including both item stages, while the prose on those exact rows says the opposite: content whys[0] 'Level 1 you win', whys[1] 'Level 2 still yours', whys[6] '2+ items Olaf falls off... your build and Guillotine execute overpower him', and the late block says the matchup flips back to you. Meanwhile stages 4-5 and 6 read 'Skill' although whys[3] and whys[4] both hand those levels to Olaf.
audit.why: Darius wins 51.56% over 1949 games. The real shape is a Darius level 1-2, an Olaf window from 3 through his first item, and a Darius late — the chart had none of it.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one group: Levels 1 and 2 to Darius, Levels 4-5 and 6 to Olaf, 2+ items to Darius. Level 3 and First item stay Olaf.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 chart entry carried a leaked LaTeX formula (R = d + a \times Stacks) and never mentioned Ragnarok, which is the entire level-6 swing.
audit.why: Ragnarok is 100/90/80s against your Guillotine's 120/100/80s — his ultimate is up more often than yours for the whole of the laning phase.
audit.corrected: Level 6 why now names Ragnarok, gives the 100s-vs-120s gap and keeps the true-damage point.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid block and spikes[1] say Ragnarok makes Olaf 'immune to your E Apprehend pull and W slow' and 'grants tenacity'. Riot's text grants neither tenacity nor slow immunity: 'He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.'
audit.why: A slow is not a disable, so Crippling Strike still bites through Ragnarok — and the immunity is conditional on him continuing to attack, which means it ends the moment he turns to leave. Telling the player their whole kit is nullified removes the two tools that still work.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok described as disable immunity that lasts only while he keeps swinging, with Crippling Strike named as the tool that still lands.

audit.why: Undertow is 9s but resets the instant he picks the axe back up; Reckless Swing is 11s at rank 1 down to 7s at rank 5 from 325 range; Tough It Out is 16s at rank 1; Ragnarok is 100s. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries all of it, including the axe-pickup reset as the reason 'wait out his Q' does not work.

audit.whatIsWrong: The do 'Anti-heal his sustain' had a body about pulling and bleeding that never explained why Grievous Wounds matters here.
audit.why: Berserker Rage scales his attack speed and life steal off missing Health, and Reckless Swing costs him Health and refunds it on a kill — so the lower he gets the more he heals and the harder he hits. Anti-heal is what stops the comeback half of that curve.
audit.corrected: Body now states the missing-health scaling and the Reckless Swing self-cost as the reason to buy it early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two don'ts had bodies copy-pasted from the trading block that did not match their headings ('Rely on your pull during his R', 'Extend his early all-in').
audit.why: Each heading names a mechanic the body never explains.
audit.corrected: Bodies replaced with the Ragnarok condition and the Berserker Rage low-health curve.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Ragnarok is 100s to your Guillotine's 120s, so his answer is up more often than yours all lane. Your ult is still true damage — his bonus armour and MR do nothing to it.

edits.before: - Olaf Ragnarok: matchup-defining — CC-immune — your pull won’t hold him. Bait it. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.
edits.after: - Olaf Ragnarok: 100s at rank 1, and it only holds while he keeps attacking — disable immunity, not slow immunity, so Crippling Strike still bites. Olaf Undertow: 9s, but picking the axe back up resets it, so never plan around waiting it out. Reckless Swing: 11s at rank 1, 325 range, true damage that costs him health. Darius Apprehend: 26s at rank 1 — hold it for the moment he stops swinging.

edits.before: Walk over his axe to deny it
CC-immune — your pull won’t hold him. Bait it. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Undertow resets when he collects the axe, so his path is telegraphed — meet him on it.

edits.before: Pull Olaf as he steps to last-hit, W slow, land the Q outer ring, weave two autos, and walk away at 3-4 stacks with the heal banked.
edits.after: Berserker Rage scales his attack speed and life steal off missing health, and Reckless Swing pays health for its damage — anti-heal cuts both.

edits.before: Your committal tool is the lane — burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Ragnarok is disable immunity, and only while he keeps swinging — when he turns to leave, your pull lands.

edits.before: Whiffing Apprehend and then fighting anyway — without the pull you have no engage, and chasing through a wave bleeds you dry.
edits.after: The lower his health the faster he swings and the more he heals, so a long trade at even health is his, not yours.

notes: Two data conflicts worth the user's attention. (1) MC_WR_TABLES.darius.olaf is 49.85 but tools/audit-run/packets/darius.json gives 51.56 for the same matchup; I used the packet figure for the chart reasoning and did not touch the table. (2) The existing do 'Walk over his axe to deny it' asserts that Darius can deny Undertow by standing on it — Riot's text only says 'If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset' and says nothing about enemies denying it, so I did not assert either way; the heading was reframed to the part that is verifiable (he has to walk to the axe to get the reset). Packet suspectName "Reckless Swing's" is a FALSE POSITIVE — it is the correct name with a possessive.
